dict.string: SunHat requires precise location to provide accurate weather-based reminders for your exact location.
SunHat needs location access to provide weather-based reminders and background updates for your locations.
SunHat needs temporary location access to set up weather-based reminders for your current location.
SunHat needs temporary location access to provide weather-based reminders while you're using the app.
SunHat needs location access to provide weather-based reminders for your current area.
